title: Fault-tolerant metric basis and dimension of barycentric subdivision of zero divisor graphs
summary: The undirected zero divisor graph of a commutative ring with unity \( R \), denoted by \( Γ(R) = (V(Γ(R)), E(Γ(R))) \). The vertex set \( V(Γ(R)) \) consists of all the non-zero zero-divisors of \( R \). The edge set \( E(Γ(R)) \) is defined by the set \( \{ e = a_1 a_2 \mid a_1 \cdot a_2 = 0 \text{ and } a_1, a_2 \in V(Γ(R)) \} \). The barycentric subdivision of $Γ$ is the process of subdividing each edge by inserting new vertex in the graph $Γ$.
